# Royal Marriage rajput Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_indianpu_events.1103
	title = cosmo_indianpu_events.1103.t
	desc = cosmo_indianpu_events.1103.d
	picture = cosmogfx_HAREM_INDIA_MENU_1A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}
				random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = rajput
				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_indianpu_events.1103.a 
		trigger = {
		has_regency = no 	
		OR = {
			has_consort = no	
			has_estate = estate_harem 	
			has_estate = estate_wives 	
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 	
			has_estate = estate_ooku 				
		}
		}
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_indianpu_events.11098
			}
		}				
	}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_indianpu_events.1103.b 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_indianpu_events.11098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		option = {#uncleson
		name = cosmo_indianpu_events.1103.c 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_indianpu_events.11098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}	
		option = {#reject
		name = cosmo_indianpu_events.1103.7 
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		
}

# Royal Marriage rajput Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_indianpu_events.1101
	title = cosmo_indianpu_events.1101.t
	desc = cosmo_indianpu_events.1101.d
	picture = cosmogfx_HAREM_INDIA_MENU_1A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = east_indies_superregion
				superregion = persia_superregion
				superregion = africa_superregion
				superregion = southern_africa_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = tartary_superregion
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_possible_here
		}
		every_subject_country = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = east_indies_superregion
				superregion = persia_superregion
				superregion = africa_superregion
				superregion = southern_africa_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = tartary_superregion
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_possible_here
		}			
		}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}				
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					capital_scope = {
			OR = {
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = east_indies_superregion
				superregion = persia_superregion
				superregion = africa_superregion
				superregion = southern_africa_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = tartary_superregion
			}
						has_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_possible_here
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}	
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_indianpu_events.1101.a 
		FROM = {
			capital_scope = { #testdelete
			set_province_flag = rajput_honeymoon_first_stop	
			}
		}
		create_marriage = FROM
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}				
		define_consort = {
			country_of_origin = FROM
			dynasty = FROM
			religion = FROM
			culture = FROM
			female = yes
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_indianharem_1a
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				FROM = {
					NOT = {
				cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
					}
				}				
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_asian_personal_union_I	
					subject = FROM	
					}
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = FROM
				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM	
				FROM = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = cosmo_indianpu_events.11031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {
			set_country_flag = rajput_ruler_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}
		cosmo_heir_married = {
			set_country_flag = rajput_heir_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
			}
		royal_marriage_uncleson = {
			set_country_flag = rajput_uncle_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
			}
		}
		}			
	}		
}

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		has_country_flag = rajput_heir_honeymoon
	NOT = {
		has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
	}
		}

	
		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 7
		}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = rajput_heir_honeymoon
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = rajput
				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_indianpu_events.11019.a 
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = rajput
				}
			}
				overlord = {
					define_consort = {
						country_of_origin = PREV
						religion = PREV
						culture = PREV
					}
				}
		}		
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort

		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoIHaremOneACounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoIHaremOneACounter	
			value = 280
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoIHaremOneACounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}

			set_province_flag = gujarati_honeymoon_first_stop	
			}
		}
		create_marriage = FROM
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}				
		define_consort = {
			country_of_origin = FROM
			dynasty = FROM
			religion = FROM
			culture = FROM
			female = yes
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_indianharem_2a
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				FROM = {
					NOT = {
				cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
					}
				}				
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_asian_personal_union_I	
					subject = FROM	
					}
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = FROM
				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM	
				FROM = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = cosmo_indianpu_events.21031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {
			set_country_flag = gujarati_ruler_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}

						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_adm_power = 1 	
						}
						}																
						}

							duration = -1  
							desc = cosmo_fertile_ruler_DESC
							hidden = no				
						}

				}

					}

country_event = {
	id = cosmo_indianpu_events.42019
	title = cosmo_indianpu_events.42019.t
	desc = cosmo_indianpu_events.42019.d
	picture = cosmogfx_HAREM_INDIA_MENU_4B_1_eventPicture

	
	trigger = {
		ai = no
		has_country_flag = kanauji_heir_honeymoon
	NOT = {
		has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
	}
		}

	
		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 7
		}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = kanauji_heir_honeymoon
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = kanauji
				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_indianpu_events.42019.a 
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = kanauji
				}
			}
				overlord = {
					define_consort = {
						country_of_origin = PREV
						religion = PREV
						culture = PREV
					}
				}
		}		
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_indianharem_5a
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoIHaremFourBCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoIHaremFourBCounter	
			value = 280
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoIHaremFourBCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}	
}
